recipes.name: Chicken Eggplant Stir-Fry
ingredients_raw: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves , cut into cubes

steps.text: Sprinkle salt evenly over both sides of eggplant slices; set aside for 5 minutes. Cut eggplant into cubes.
Cook and stir chicken, garlic, and soy sauce together in a large skillet over medium heat until the chicken is nearly cooked through, 7 to 10 minutes.
Stir mushrooms and black pepper into the chicken mixture; continue cooking until the mushrooms brown, 2 to 3 minutes.
Heat canola oil in a separate skillet over medium heat. Cook eggplant in hot canola oil until lightly browned; add to skillet with the chicken.
Stir spinach through the chicken and eggplant mixture; cook and stir until the spinach wilts, 2 to 3 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Chicken Eggplant Stir-Fry
raw_recipe.description: Stir-fry cubed chicken breast with mushrooms, spinach, eggplant, and soy sauce for a quick and easy main dish.

review.reviewBody: We loved this recipe! It is quick and easy, and healthy. (I used coconut oil inplace of Canola) Readers should be aware that when you first add a whole bag of spinach it looks like a mistake! But it quickly cooks down and the dish looks beautiful. My kids think they don't like eggplant, and turn their nose up at spinach. But everyone loves this dish.

Really Good!! I love eggplant, so I used the whole large eggplant for this recipe. I cooked the chicken with cooking spray, salt, pepper, minced garlic & soy to brown/sear it (couple min per side), and then added the mushrooms AND maybe ~ a cup of chicken broth - let it simmer, covered on med-low for about 15 min. At minute 12, I added the spinach and cooked eggplant & re-covered the pan for the last 3 min. (I cubed the eggplant & cooked it in the canola, added minced garlic & soy as it cooked on Med/Med-low ~5-7 min) Turned out fantastic!! Served over rice. I will make this again! Thanks for the recipe!

Here's what I did;
Stir-fry the chicken, then mushrooms in the hot oil until brown, then add the garlic for 1 minute then add the liquid which was 2T soy, 2T Mirin, 2T water into which I had stirred 1t of cornstarch. I stir-fried the eggplant in 2T of coconut oil until browning, then added it to the chicken/mushroom mix, stir, lower the heat and covered for 5 minutes. Then did the spinach for the last minute or 2. It came out great with a nice sauce for the plain white rice.

This was a delightful combination, but I did make some changes. I used boneless, skinless thighs because they have more flavor and moisture and pair better with the eggplant. Make sure you sweat the eggplant first, while the chicken is marinating. I marinated the chicken in soy sauce, fish sauce, and some sesame oil for about 15-20 minutes before cooking. I cooked the chicken with a sliced onion and then added the mushrooms, followed by the eggplant once the mushrooms released their juices. I used portobello mushrooms and since I did not have spinach, I used swiss chard. I made it a second time and used baby zucchini. Any green vegetable works well. A bit of red pepper helps if you like some spice.

Initially I rated this recipe 3. I rated this recipe a 4 because it was average, yet an excellent dinner because it can be a keto recipe by replacing the soy sauce with coconut aminos. Furthermore, I doubled the coconut amino for a juicer dish. The next day I topped the leftovers with siracha and though it was really good.

This is surprisingly tasty. Just the soy sauce (I used Braggs Aminos) and ground black pepper. Only added some red peppers as someone else suggested because I had some. Cooked chicken, mushrooms, peppers and garlic together. Browning the eggplant in a separate skillet is key. Then all together with the spinach...yum! Definitely use coconut or olive oil...never, never canola!

This is a great simple and delicious recipe. I added vidalia onions and a little brown sugar and allspice to the soy sauce. I also sprinkled a bit of red crushed pepper. (I like it spicy). It came out great! Did not have any portobello mushrooms on hand, so I used regular mushrooms. Did not seem to affect the dish. I highly recommend this tasty, easy to make dish.

What a lovely recipe! I just so happened to have all the ingredients while looking for an easy meal. I did add a tablespoon or two of hoisin sauce and a tiny bit of ginger, to add a little bit of depth.....then served it over homemade fried rice. My husband said this was restaurant quality. Thank you for this recipe!

It was easy and very delicious. I used broccoli flowerets. instead of the spinach and I added a little whine wine to the chicken. I served it with cauliflower fried rice. So it was a veggie and protein meal.

I enjoyed the recipe but wish there was more of a sauce to it. I would recommend pouring some soy sauce over the eggplant while it fries and before adding them into the chicken mixture, otherwise they're a little bland.
Added more veggies and Japanese mirin to the sauce (thicken sauce with corn starch or potato starch)
Taste really good For a little sweetness add pineapple for a sweet and salty flavor
Made it exactly like stated. We did not like it tasted too earthy. Will not make it again and took it off my favorites list.
This was very good and I enjoyed it very much. Instead of spinach I used zucchini veggie spirals.
Delicious. Served with white rice. Very flavorful. I read that salting the eggplant brings out the flavor and I believe it surely did. Will try that with other eggplant recipes as well.
Simple and great way to use eggplant in the summer!

Love, love this recipe! It's my favorite go-to recipe for fast, easy, healthy, and delicious. Who could have guessed that my whole family (including grandkids) would love eggplant! And SPINACH! I usually take liberties with new recipes; I am creative and adventurous and confident. But I like this one just as it is... I didn't change a thing. (Except the instructions a little.) BTW, that photo in no way resembles the final product. Mine, anyway. (Mine looks prettier.) Thanks for this recipe!!!
The combination of eggplant ,mushrooms and spinach is not a common one but this was delicious. Great way to fix eggplant without adding tons of calories. A definite keeper..
Very tasty, I added red bell pepper and red and green poblano peppers. It was awesome
Loved it. Quick and easy and I had all ingredients. Husband loved it too.
